description: This file defines a CustomEditor class extending an existing Editor class, adding custom key handling and event callbacks for various key combinations and actions within a text-based user interface.

classes.name: CustomEditor
classes.description: A subclass of Editor that provides custom input handling with additional key event callbacks.

methods.name: handleInput
methods.description: Processes input data to trigger appropriate callback functions based on matched key combinations, or delegates to the superclass otherwise.
